About Marilyn

The leather armchair designed by Draga&Aurel is an easy chair with a wide and comfortable seat, an ultra-light and streamlined shell with a vintage feel, and sinuous and generous forms. These are the standout features of Marilyn. Its fluid profile is reminiscent of an enveloping and comfortable nest in which to snuggle down, a warm embrace in which to sit back and relax. The swivel seat gently cradles while guaranteeing freedom of movement. Attractive yet sophisticated, young and original, thanks to its leather upholstery the armchair not only adds character to spaces but also texture and depth.
